summaries_ref.lecture_01_ml_intro.wav: Introduction to fundamental concepts of machine learning as a subset of AI enabling computers to learn from data.

summaries_ref.lecture_03_neural_networks.wav: Biological brain-inspired neural networks feature layered architectures of input, hidden, and output nodes.
summaries_ref.lecture_04_gradient_descent.wav: Gradient descent minimizes the loss function iteratively scaled by the learning rate hyperparameter.
summaries_ref.lecture_05_overfitting_regularization.wa: Overfitting causes poor generalization on unseen test data, mitigated via L1 and L2 regularization.
summaries_ref.lecture_06_backpropagation_math.wav: Backpropagation computes error gradients with respect to network weights applying the calculus chain rule.
summaries_ref.lecture_07_support_vector_machines.wav: SVM finds the maximum-margin separating hyperplane, utilizing the kernel trick for non-linear feature mapping.
summaries_ref.lecture_08_convolutional_layers.wav: CNNs leverage convolution filters and spatial pooling for computer vision feature extraction.
summaries_ref.lecture_09_recurrent_architectures.wav: RNNs model sequential temporal dependencies but encounter vanishing gradient bottlenecks over long contexts.
summaries_ref.lecture_10_attention_mechanisms.wav: The Transformer self-attention mechanism weights the relational significance of tokens dynamically across the sequence.
summaries_ref.lecture_11_pipelining_hazards.wav: Instruction pipelining improves processor throughput via concurrent instruction phases, prone to structural, data, and control stalls.
summaries_ref.lecture_12_cache_coherence.wav: MESI cache coherence protocols maintain data consistency across distributed L1/L2 caches in multiprocessor systems.
summaries_ref.lecture_13_virtual_memory_paging.wav: Virtual memory uses page tables and TLB hardware caches to translate logical addresses into physical RAM frames.
summaries_ref.lecture_14_branch_prediction.wav: Two-level branch prediction reduces control pipeline bubble penalties through speculative instruction fetching.
summaries_ref.lecture_15_cuda_memory_hierarchy.wav: GPU acceleration requires optimal utilization of register files, fast shared scratchpads, and high-bandwidth global memory.
summaries_ref.lecture_16_acid_properties.wav: ACID guarantees transactional integrity, fault tolerance, and isolation across concurrent database operations.
summaries_ref.lecture_17_indexing_b_trees.wav: B+ Trees maintain balanced logarithmic index search structures optimized for block-level secondary storage access.
summaries_ref.lecture_18_raft_consensus.wav: Raft orchestrates distributed cluster consensus using leader election, heartbeats, and committed log replication.

summaries_ref.lecture_20_kubernetes_orchestration.wav: Kubernetes provides container orchestration automating cluster deployment, horizontal scaling, and health monitoring.
